content: Install LiveKit dependencies in backend (livekit-api, livekit-agents with plugins, deepgram)
Add LiveKit credentials to backend .env (LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY, LIVEKIT_API_SECRET)
Create backend endpoint POST /api/livekit/session/start for token generation
Create LiveKit agent worker script (lecture_agent.py) with GPT-4 + Cartesia TTS
Install livekit-client in frontend (yarn add livekit-client)
Add Start Session button to LectureList component
Create SessionDialog component for LiveKit room connection
Test POC: manual test of token generation, agent greeting, basic conversation
